text: Laws tab only describes the law currently in force (e.g. 'No tax: members keep their coin'); the effect of High taxes (3 coins/10s, loyalty falls fast, no immigrants) and Conscription On (members gather 40% less) is only revealed after it is enacted and has taken effect 30 s later. No hover/preview of an option before choosing it. Also a 1-member nation shows 'Taxes: 0 coins' with no hint taxes need members.
Near Smalltown the floating settlement label 'Town of Smalltown / 5 here, 7/12 residents' is drawn underneath the red status banner at the top centre, so both are partly unreadable (tick ~4450).

Recruiting is very hard: pawns are Strangers ('I don't even know you' needs Acquaintance), and after one E-talk they walk off; repeated E presses 1 s later say 'No entities within range'. pt walkto repeatedly times out chasing pawns at ~3 fps. Within ~15 min every nearby pawn had founded/joined its own nation (10+ nations by day 1 morning), so a solo player nation stays at 1 member.

No ruler/heir information anywhere a player can see: Nations tab says only 'You lead it', Laws tab, Player Info (Role: LEADER) and all 3 pages of ? Controls never mention an heir, succession, or what happens if the ruler dies. A player trying to plan a dynasty cannot learn who would succeed them.

Conscription: Off proclaimed at tick 4574 ('takes effect in 30 seconds'). At tick ~6200 (32+ game s later) the Laws tab reads 'Conscription: On (Off in 0 s)' and the law is still On. Earlier changes landed exactly on ticks 2002 and 4002, so laws seem to apply only on a 2000-tick (40 s) cadence: the countdown hits 0 s and then sits there for up to ~40 s more.
